arguments.text: 6000 m, out-and-back legs of 1250 m (turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000 m; last 1000 m is leg 5 out). Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) check instruments: pod vs heart rate vs GPS (pod drift, strap, GPS faults); out-and-back leg pairs cancel current, so compare legs() and measure() share each pair. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg -> clear_rudder (pacer also does). (3) check critical power from heart rate (levels off below CP, climbs above). (4) radio/course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (5) finish: pacer pushes only if pod reserve >40% under 800 m; if reserve is 10-40% near ~1000 m to go, spend it with a piece (+effort) timed to empty at the line. Save cues (20 max).

arguments.description: push_local mean of the 2 min before the last 20 s minus the last 20 s (positive = local push fell, e.g. weed); only meaningful within a leg

5.7 min: paddler says cooked, 10/10, hurting. Pod reserve 25%, shaft ~174 W = pod CP 172. HR flat 172-175 since 126 s even though power fell 260->172 at 120-150 s (ceiling? or depletion term). HR moves ~0.4 bpm/W with small power changes, so not hard-pinned. Test: piece -6% for 120 s from 345 s (test_cost ~0 s). If HR drops ~4 bpm -> not at ceiling, paddler likely pessimistic; if flat -> suspect reserve near empty / CP low.

Pacer sets effort but its finish push needs pod reserve >40% under 800 m, and its ease rule is over (past 35%). Keep checking: pod vs HR (no drift so far), weed (push_local drop within a leg), further radio. Paddler self-report pessimistic (said cooked at 25% reserve).

arguments.text: COURSE 4750 m (radio at 667 s; distance set; paddler told). Last turn at 3750 m, finish 1000 m into leg 4 (southbound). Pacer finish push needs pod reserve >40% under 800 m, so I spend the reserve myself: piece 1 = +10% for 240 s from ~1045 s; at ~750 m to go send piece 2 sized to empty the pod reserve at the line (HR all race says CP is not over-stated). Speed loss on leg 3 north (~0.15 m/s) not cured by a back-stroke -> likely current/wind; confirm leg 4 south is faster. Paddler complains (hurting) but HR/power say fine; reassure if they self-ease.
